_comment: Frozen retrieval-quality baseline for the currently-shipped model. This is the recorded reference the CI metric-regression gate (ml/eval/test_metric_regression.py) guards against: if a future model / eval report drops a guarded metric below (reference - tolerance) on the fixed test subset, CI fails. Update these reference values ONLY when a new model is intentionally promoted (re-record from its committed eval report). Values copied verbatim from the shipped model's committed eval report so the gate currently passes with tolerance headroom.
